caption: The drawing shows a wooden duck decoy lying on a plain, light beige background. The decoy is depicted in profile, facing left. It has a moderately long neck, a flat and slightly upturned bill, and a smoothly rounded body. The head and upper part of the body are colored in dark brown and black tones, especially concentrated on the crown, nape, and around the eye. The eye is orange with a black pupil. The lower part of the body is rendered in lighter shades of brown, with visible wood grain textures accentuated by the drawing. There is a coiled string attached near the lower front of the decoy, hanging loosely onto the background. Below the duck decoy, the words "Max Sterncke 1938" are written in small, neat script. The composition is minimal, with the decoy centered on an otherwise empty background.
title: Duck Decoy
